task: Actual bounded file preparation must first pass a modelled capacity admission constraint. A later independent worker must verify its actual bytes and commit. A repeated same-worker attempt is rejected, generating only its actually observed tactile result.
phase_visibility_R01: No extra phase or previous-worker signal injected. DEE has its own past experience and the two current raw values. This intentionally tests whether source scalar comparison alone suffices, not whether Python can select the other worker.
main_criterion: At least two verified transactions within six opportunities; count accepted preparation/commit steps separately from whole transactions.
